rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (Senate bill S.2983)
rules.requirement: A Massachusetts bill would prohibit algorithmic rent setting. It is not law yet. The Housing Committee reported it favorably on 3/12/2026 and sent it to Senate Ways and Means, so renters cannot rely on it now.
rules.requirement_es: Un proyecto de ley de Massachusetts prohibiría la fijación algorítmica de alquileres. Todavía no es ley: el Comité de Vivienda lo informó favorablemente el 12/3/2026 y lo remitió al Comité de Medios y Arbitrios del Senado, por lo que los inquilinos aún no pueden depender de él.
rules.quoted_span: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.caveat: Only the bill history page is provided, not the bill text. Definitions, prohibited conduct, and penalties are not shown. The bill is a new draft of S994 and S1016 and is pending in Senate Ways and Means.
